document.title: Grow your YouTube

source.description_exact: Get YouTube subscribers via IG DMs. Turn your IG audience into YouTube subscribers without begging. Just sneak that subscribe CTA into your DMs like a smooth operator
source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
Grow your YouTube
Business value
Your Instagram content now fuels YouTube growth. Fewer dead-end Reels. More subscribers, more monetization, more clout.
How does it work?
Drop a teaser Reel. Ask people to comment a keyword. Manychat DMs them the full YouTube video link and tells them to smash that red button.
